newsitem.title: UK: St Paul aims to expand UK home insurance mkt.
newsitem.headline: St Paul aims to expand UK home insurance mkt.

text.p: U.S. insurer St Paul International on Monday said it was offering more competitive terms on its household insurance to older, well off customers as part of its strategy to increase market share.
"Household is well established in the UK and very competitive. We're adopting a more imaginative approach to try to gain more market share," marketing manager Peter Elliott told Reuters.
St Paul has set a target of 10 million stg gross premiums on UK household by the beginning of 2000, he said, adding that the company had only entered the market 18 months ago.
"We're taking a long term view and targeting policies that fall outside the standard bedroom rated policies," Elliott said.

Affluent over 65 year old homeowners with contents worth between 100,000 and 250,000 stg are St Paul's core target market. They will be offered an age discount of 20 percent, compared with five percent at present, plus other benefits.
